description: This Java source file implements the MacroMenuRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering menu components using FreeMarker macros within the OFBiz framework. It handles rendering menu open/close tags, individual menu items, links, images, and executing macros defined in a macro library. The class integrates with OFBiz's theming, URL construction, and template systems to produce dynamic, macro-based menu HTML output.

classes.name: MacroMenuRenderer
classes.description: This class implements the MenuStringRenderer interface to provide macro-based rendering of menus within the OFBiz web framework. It manages macro execution, macro library loading, and rendering logic for menu components, links, and images, integrating with the template system and web request/response objects.
